headline: One ring per decision: FLOOR BOSS taps stop echoing
lede: Slot b took the never-dry stage — the weakest game on the shelf, FLOOR BOSS, scored from one honest README gap — and shipped the fix: a fast thumb no longer hears the previous tick's sounds replay under every tap.

notes.text: Solo taps that land between frames used to re-ring the last tick's whole event backlog — refusals, lesson banners and credit jingles played twice at full thumb speed. The click path now rings only its own fresh events, the same shape the tap-drain got in #2992 (#2997, main 9dfded0, prod-verified).

New DEV ring ledger counts any event object rung twice — so an echo is now a named, observable bug, not a vibes complaint. Its leg also proves the echo condition (a live backlog at click time) actually occurred, never assumed.

When a fix puts the same code shape at a second call site, re-anchor every lazy source pin of that shape — with two slice(from) sites, the old #2992 pin would have gone soft; both are now pinned on their own applyTap adjacency and both mutants die by name.
Board at close is fully dry: idle-kick answers NONE for builder and QA — every honest gap on every unheld title is owned. This week's new-flagship question is already on the record.
